contributionSummary: Adds dry_run to /staff sync_nickname (MB-08): same per-member decisions as a live run with no setNickname call, ephemeral reply with counts, a sample and a CSV of changes, skipped staff and failures; dry-run logs carry counts only. Docs no longer call bulk nickname sync dev-only.

publicNote.description: Staff can now preview a nickname sync before running it. The new dry run option on /staff sync_nickname lists every nickname a real sync would change, including names someone edited by hand, and every staff member it would skip, without changing anyone's nickname.

commits.subject: fix(staff): keep nicknames and failure lists out of dry-run logs
